title: 梓如商旅授权
description: 填写梓如商旅提供的访问令牌，用于查询航班、车次与酒店，以及退票/改签、差标查询。令牌仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Enter the access token issued by Ziru Business Travel to query flights, trains and hotels, and to generate refund/rebooking links or query travel standards. It is stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and never uploaded to the cloud.
docLabel_en: How to get the access token?

fields.label: 访问令牌
fields.placeholder: 打开授权页登录后选择所属公司，复制页面上的 MCP Key
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in on the authorization page, choose your company, then copy the MCP Key
fields.description: 用于访问梓如商旅查询与退改接口的令牌。
fields.description_en: Token for accessing the Ziru Business Travel query and refund/rebooking APIs.
